command: the side command of demos/bench/run.ts, once per side, 4 rounds over tree4:10000,chain:10000,tree4:50000,chain:50000 with the sides interleaved and the order rotated by round and cell, --dnf-s 120, --memory-at-s 20, quiet cap load1 under 4
driverOptions: the driver's defaults, the same for both sides (--dnf-s 120, --memory-at-s 20)
method: One generator run gives every side the same tasks, links and dates, and each side loads its own file of that data in its own shape (DHTMLX its own file; ours the ours.json that it hands to mount(el, { tasks, links }) on demos/bench/sides/ours-page.html). Memory is the browser total 20 s after the navigation, the page idle. The comparison is load and draw: DHTMLX community cannot schedule, and ours solves the schedule on open. The harness of the 0.4.0 release (7ecb106, the harness and ours fields above) drove every run of both sides; the ours page is built from main at 45f38c4 (its bundleSha256 is in each side.json). A third page, an earlier build, ran interleaved in the same session as a check on the machine; its runs are not in this file.
tree: The runs are the directories in 2026-11-22/ beside this file: <cell>/<round>/<side>/{result.json,side.json,load.log,wait.log}; the medians below are over the matched pairs of each cell (cells.<cell>.matched), and a pair not matched is listed in that cell's note. dataset.json is not kept: node demos/bench/dataset.ts --shape <shape> --size <n> --seed 20261020 --out <dir> rebuilds it byte for byte, and its SHA-256 is in each cell above.

chain-50000.note: pair 3 not matched: load1 means differ by 1.14 (limit 0.5), or a result refused or swap grew; kept and listed, not counted

tree4-10000.note: pair 4 not matched: load1 means differ by 0.76 (limit 0.5), or a result refused or swap grew; kept and listed, not counted; pair 6 not matched: load1 means differ by 0.56 (limit 0.5), or a result refused or swap grew; kept and listed, not counted

tree4-50000.note: pair 3 not matched: load1 means differ by 0.82 (limit 0.5), or a result refused or swap grew; kept and listed, not counted; pair 5 not matched: load1 means differ by 0.60 (limit 0.5), or a result refused or swap grew; kept and listed, not counted

box.quietCap: load1 under 4 before each run (--max-load 4, not raised)
box.wallClock: 2026-11-22 07:31 to 08:31 MST, 4 runs per cell and side; two users were logged in
